name: ToucH Mou Ichido Kono te ga Fureru Sekai
original_name: ToucH もう一度この手が触れる世界
source:
Main character lives in a ruined abandoned house waiting for this place to disappear. Actually, he is a ghost. He explores Seven Wonders of the school to find other spirits inside and outside the school.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-august-2006-eve-new.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角住在一栋等待消失的废弃房屋里。其实，他是个幽灵。他探索学校七大不可思议，在校内外寻找其他灵魂。

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-august-2006-eve-new.html]VNDB Review[/url]]
